svg.text: Control plane on Kubernetes · untrusted code in Firecracker microVMs · one model gateway · Git as the source of truth · scale-to-zero app hosting
tool calls run in the VM via envd
service mesh (mTLS) · every service is stateless and reads/writes the data tier ↓
2 vCPU · 4 GB · 10 GB disk · non-root user
no host access · own kernel · jailer + seccomp
ports exposed only through the Preview Proxy
Start on E2B (managed Firecracker); move to self-hosted on bare metal at scale.
App hosting: Knative on K8s (or Cloud Run)
revision per deploy · scale-to-zero · min/max instances
preview environment per branch · instant rollback
Static assets are served from the CDN.
User types a prompt → CDN → API Gateway (session JWT)
Project Service saves it; client opens a WebSocket
Orchestrator starts a Temporal run; claims a warm microVM
Harness asks the Model Gateway for a plan; user approves
Tool loop: model → tool call → envd in VM → result → model
Dev server hot-reloads; Preview Proxy streams it to the iframe
Verify → git commit (checkpoint) → Git Service pushes to GitHub
Publish → preflight → Deploy Service builds image from the SHA
Knative revision + DB branch + secrets → health check → 100%
End users hit app.architect.app → App Ingress → revision
